candidates: When adding inline Vite plugin objects to `finalConfig.plugins` in `builder-vite`, annotate each object with `as PluginOption` or `satisfies PluginOption` (with `PluginOption` imported from `'vite'`) so TypeScript validates the shape against the installed Vite version. Because `builder-vite` supports Vite `^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0 || ^7.0.0`, any hook that was introduced in a later major—such as `configEnvironment` (Vite 6+)—must be either gated behind a runtime Vite-version check or omitted entirely; including it unconditionally will cause a TypeScript compile error for consumers on Vite 5.
